storeDescriptionHtml:
The ten most downloaded apps on F-Droid, with App Dev for All's Code on the Go and Knowledge to Go.

This is a demo store: every download is a small placeholder, not the real app or its source. Follow each app's link to get the real one.

products.name: F-Droid
products.descriptionHtml:
The app store for free and open-source Android apps. It installs apps from F-Droid's catalogue and keeps them up to date.

Get it from F-Droid.

products.name: Termux
products.descriptionHtml:
A terminal emulator with a full Linux package collection. Run shells, editors, compilers and command-line tools on your phone.

Get it from F-Droid.

products.name: Aurora Store
products.descriptionHtml:
An unofficial, open-source client for Google Play. Search for, download and update Play Store apps, with or without Google services.

Get it from F-Droid.

products.name: Fennec F-Droid
products.descriptionHtml:
A web browser built from Firefox's source, packaged for F-Droid. Private browsing, add-ons and tracking protection.

Get it from F-Droid.

products.name: DAVx⁵
products.descriptionHtml:
Syncs calendars, contacts and tasks with your own server over CalDAV and CardDAV, so they work in your phone's usual apps.

Get it from F-Droid.

products.name: Thunderbird
products.descriptionHtml:
The open-source email app from the makers of Thunderbird for desktop. Several accounts, one inbox, and no tracking.

Get it from F-Droid.

products.name: Proton VPN
products.descriptionHtml:
A VPN from the makers of Proton Mail, with a free plan and a no-logs policy. Encrypts your connection on public Wi-Fi.

Get it from F-Droid.

products.name: PipePipe
products.descriptionHtml:
A lightweight, privacy-friendly player for YouTube and other video sites, without ads or an account. It began as a fork of NewPipe.

Get it from F-Droid.

products.name: Organic Maps
products.descriptionHtml:
Offline maps and navigation from OpenStreetMap data, for walking, cycling and driving, with no tracking or ads.

Get it from F-Droid.

products.name: Librera Reader
products.descriptionHtml:
A reader for ebooks and documents — PDF, EPUB, MOBI and more — with bookmarks, notes and text-to-speech.

Get it from F-Droid.

products.name: Code on the Go (32-bit)
products.descriptionHtml:
A complete Android development environment that runs on your phone. Write, debug and build Kotlin and Java apps with no computer and no internet.

32-bit version: for phones that run only 32-bit apps, such as many low-cost and Android Go phones. If the 64-bit version won't install, use this one.

Get it from App Dev for All.

products.name: Code on the Go (64-bit)
products.descriptionHtml:
A complete Android development environment that runs on your phone. Write, debug and build Kotlin and Java apps with no computer and no internet.

64-bit version: for most phones from recent years. If Android says it isn't compatible with your phone, use the 32-bit version.

Get it from App Dev for All.

products.name: Knowledge to Go (32-bit)
products.descriptionHtml:
Turns an Android phone into an offline library for everyone nearby: Wikipedia, books, maps, lessons and more, shared over local Wi-Fi. Built on Internet-in-a-Box.

32-bit version: for phones that run only 32-bit apps, such as many low-cost and Android Go phones. If the 64-bit version won't install, use this one.

Get it from App Dev for All.

products.descriptionHtml:
Turns an Android phone into an offline library for everyone nearby: Wikipedia, books, maps, lessons and more, shared over local Wi-Fi. Built on Internet-in-a-Box.

64-bit version: for most phones from recent years. If Android says it isn't compatible with your phone, use the 32-bit version.

Get it from App Dev for All.

products.name: Knowledge to Go (universal)
products.descriptionHtml:
Turns an Android phone into an offline library for everyone nearby: Wikipedia, books, maps, lessons and more, shared over local Wi-Fi. Built on Internet-in-a-Box.

Universal version: works on any phone, 32-bit or 64-bit, but it's a larger download.

Get it from App Dev for All.
